single.rationale: Matson operates a defensible Jones Act-protected niche serving Hawaii, Alaska, and Guam, with steady cash generation and disciplined capital allocation (reducing share count 5.8% annually). However, revenues have declined at an 8.3% CAGR over three years, operating margins compressed from 33% (2022) to 15% (2025), and management guides flat-to-modest growth for 2026. The China business faces tariff/geopolitical uncertainty despite recent stabilization, and Jones Act repeal risk, while remote, represents existential vulnerability.
